actions: window.__order = b => [...document.querySelectorAll(`tbody.combo-group[data-bucket="${b}"]`)].map(g => g.dataset.comboId).slice(0, 12).join(' '); window.__drag = async (fromId, toId) => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const from = document.querySelector(`tbody.combo-group[data-combo-id="${fromId}"]`); const handle = from.querySelector('.row-drag-handle'); const target = document.querySelector(`tbody.combo-group[data-combo-id="${toId}"]`); handle.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(150); const a = handle.getBoundingClientRect(); const t = target.getBoundingClientRect(); const fire = (el, type, x, y) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1, pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true })); const sx = a.left + a.width / 2, sy = a.top + a.height / 2; const tx = sx, ty = t.top + t.height * 0.75; fire(handle, 'pointerdown', sx, sy); await sleep(60); for (let i = 1; i <= 14; i++) { const y = sy + (ty - sy) * i / 14; fire(document, 'pointermove', sx, y); await sleep(70); } await sleep(300); fire(document, 'pointerup', tx, ty); await sleep(350); return 'dragged'; }; 'ready'
